info.name: Paged API
info.description:
Full API collection for Paged — a full-stack notes app with email/password + Google auth, notes, many-to-many tags, and an optional Gemini-backed AI layer (tag suggestions, semantic search, AI chat).

How to use:
1. Set the `baseUrl` collection variable (defaults to http://localhost:3000).
2. Run "Auth > Sign up" or "Auth > Sign in" first — Postman's cookie jar stores the `paged_session` cookie that response sets, and every other request in this collection reuses it automatically.
3. Run any other request individually, or the whole collection top-to-bottom.

See the project README's "API architecture & endpoints" and "Testing with Postman" sections for more context.

variable.description: Set automatically by 'Create note' (see its Tests script)
Set automatically by 'Create tag' (see its Tests script)

request.description:
Creates an account, hashes the password with bcrypt, and immediately signs in (sets the `paged_session` httpOnly cookie).

Expected response — 201 Created:
```json
{ "user": { "id": "clx...", "email": "demo@example.com" } }
```

Errors:
- 400 if email/password fail validation (password must be 8-72 chars)
- 409 if the email is already registered

Signs in with email/password and sets the `paged_session` cookie.

Expected response — 200 OK:
```json
{ "user": { "id": "clx...", "email": "demo@example.com" } }
```

Errors:
- 400 `{ "error": "Invalid email or password" }` for either a wrong password or an unknown email — deliberately identical, so a caller can't use the error to enumerate registered emails.

Returns the signed-in user for the current session cookie, or null if signed out. Does not require auth (never 401s).

Expected response — 200 OK:
```json
{ "user": { "id": "clx...", "email": "demo@example.com" } }
```
or, when signed out:
```json
{ "user": null }
```

Redirects to Google's OAuth consent screen. This is meant to be opened in a browser, not called from Postman/a script — Google's consent flow requires an interactive user. Only present once `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`/`GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET` are configured on the server.

Expected response: 302 redirect to accounts.google.com, with a CSRF `state` value stashed in a short-lived cookie.

The matching `GET /api/auth/google/callback?code=...&state=...` is invoked by Google itself after the user approves — it is not meant to be called directly either.

Clears the session cookie. Requires an active session.

Expected response — 200 OK:
```json
{ "ok": true }
```

query.description: Repeatable — one or more tag ids, OR semantics
ISO instant (inclusive lower bound on createdAt) — an absolute timestamp, not a bare date, so timezone is never ambiguous
ISO instant (inclusive upper bound on createdAt); either bound may be given alone for an open-ended range

request.description:
Lists the signed-in user's notes, newest first by default. Requires auth. `createdFrom`/`createdTo` filter by creation date and combine (AND) with `q` and `tagId` — this is the same query the notes list's search box, tag chips, and date-filter popover all build together. Expected response — 200 OK: ```json { "notes": [ { "id": "clx...", "title": "Wedding planning", "body": "

Book the venue

", "favorite": false, "createdAt": "2026-08-27T12:00:00.000Z", "updatedAt": "2026-08-27T12:00:00.000Z", "tags": [{ "id": "clx...", "name": "Wedding", "color": "blue" }] } ] } ``` Errors: - 400 if `createdFrom` is after `createdTo`

Creates a note. `body` is sanitized HTML server-side regardless of what's sent (see the README's "Rich text editing & copy/paste" section) and `title` is required. Saves the created note's id into the `noteId` collection variable for the requests below. Expected response — 201 Created: ```json { "note": { "id": "clx...", "title": "Wedding planning", "body": "

Book the venue and send invites.

", "favorite": false, "createdAt": "...", "updatedAt": "...", "tags": [] } } ```

Fetches a single note by id. Requires auth and ownership.

Expected response — 200 OK: `{ "note": { ... } }` (same shape as List notes).

Errors:
- 404 if the note doesn't exist **or** belongs to another user — deliberately indistinguishable from "doesn't exist" (never 403).

Partially updates a note — any of `title`, `body`, `favorite`, `tagIds` (all optional, at least one required). Used for both autosave-while-typing and one-off actions like toggling favorite.

Expected response — 200 OK: `{ "note": { ...updated fields... } }`

Errors:
- 400 if no fields are provided, or a `tagIds` entry isn't one of your own tags
- 404 if the note isn't yours

Attaches an existing tag to a note (run "Tags > Create tag" first to populate `{{tagId}}`). Idempotent — attaching a tag that's already on the note is a no-op, not an error. A dedicated endpoint rather than a full `tagIds` replacement, specifically so two rapid attach calls (e.g. accepting two AI suggestions back-to-back) can't race and drop one.

Expected response — 200 OK: `{ "note": { ...with the tag now in "tags"... } }`

Errors:
- 400 if `tagId` isn't a valid id shape
- 404 if the note or the tag isn't yours

Detaches a tag from a note without deleting the tag itself.

Expected response — 200 OK: `{ "note": { ...without that tag... } }`

Errors:
- 404 if the note isn't yours (removing a tag that was never attached is a no-op, not an error)

Deletes a note (and its tag associations, via cascade). Requires ownership.

Expected response — 204 No Content (empty body).

Errors:
- 404 if the note isn't yours

Lists the signed-in user's tags, alphabetically.

Expected response — 200 OK:
```json
{ "tags": [ { "id": "clx...", "name": "Wedding", "color": "blue" } ] }
```

Creates a tag. `color` is optional (one of `blue`, `orange`, `teal`, `green`, `pink`, `purple`, `brown` — defaults to `blue`). Idempotent by name: creating a tag with a name you already have returns your existing tag (keeping its current color) instead of erroring or duplicating. Saves the returned tag's id into the `tagId` collection variable.

Expected response — 201 Created:
```json
{ "tag": { "id": "clx...", "name": "Wedding", "color": "blue" } }
```

Errors:
- 400 if `name` is empty/too long or `color` isn't one of the presets

Deletes a tag and detaches it from every note (cascades via the join table) — the notes themselves are untouched.

Expected response — 204 No Content.

Errors:
- 404 if the tag isn't yours

Suggests 2-3 tags for a note's title/body. Never errors out for missing AI config — falls back to a local keyword-frequency heuristic when `GEMINI_API_KEY` is unset, and to the same heuristic if the Gemini call times out, rate-limits, or fails. Requires auth.

Expected response — 200 OK:
```json
{ "suggestions": ["Wedding", "Planning", "Budget"] }
```

One turn of the sidebar's "Ask AI" chat widget. `messages` is the full conversation so far (role `user` or `model`), capped at 40 messages / 4000 chars each; only the most recent 20 are actually sent to Gemini. Requires auth. Unlike tag suggestion, there's no offline fallback for open-ended chat — this endpoint (and the button that calls it) is only reachable at all when `GEMINI_API_KEY` is configured, since the key never reaches the browser and there's nothing meaningful to fall back to.

Expected response — 200 OK:
```json
{ "reply": "1. Set a firm budget upfront..." }
```

Errors:
- 400 `{ "error": "AI chat isn't configured on this deployment" }` if `GEMINI_API_KEY` is unset
- 400 if `messages` is empty or malformed
